instruction: Open the image "/home/user/logo.png" in GIMP and convert it to a Microsoft Word .docx document with the image embedded.

metadata.explanation: This task is infeasible because GIMP is an image editing application and cannot create or export to Microsoft Word .docx format, which is a word processing document format. Creating .docx files requires word processing software like LibreOffice Writer or Microsoft Word.

llm_judge_reasons: Task correctly marked as infeasible - GIMP cannot create or export to .docx format
GIMP is an image editing application with no word processing capabilities
The instruction requires functionality that GIMP fundamentally does not provide (creating .docx documents)
The infeasible() evaluator function is the appropriate choice for this impossible task
